propositions: ADR 0101 must be created as an amendment to ADR 0043 to record the rename from 'operator' to '[operator-attested]' and explain why agents misinterpreted 'operator' as requiring a human when agent attestations are equally valid

ADR 0101 must document why '[non-codebase]' was introduced as the missing counterpart to '[codebase]' to prevent attestation laundering and clarify the distinction from 'codebase-verifiable' category in criteria_routing.json
ADR 0101 must explain why 'attested' alone was rejected due to semantic conflict with SOURCE_ATTESTED read-root mode despite no functional collision
ADR 0101 must record that '[operator-attested]' remains accepted and deliberately undocumented because 827 of 4,285 live tickets carry it in immutable event records
ADR 0043 must remain unmodified as a historical record, following the precedent set by ADR 0061
ADR index scripts must be run and validation checks must pass after ADR 0101 is added
